notes: Budget: 6 of 6 WebSearch calls used (hard cap reached). 26 of 60 WebFetch used. Sport Card Expo: all four organizer sites (Calgary, Edmonton, Halifax, Montreal) show only 2026 editions that have already happened, with no table counts, vendor applications or 2027 dates, so none is recorded; they are leads_only. Collectors Supershow: the only future date in region-adjacent results is Feb 12 to 14 2027 at The International Centre with no city on the page; it is leads_only for the Ontario sweep. Festival Hobby Dec 5 and 6 2026 may be in Montreal but the page does not say so; high priority lead. Venue conflicts, organizer page used in each case: Calgary (Genesis Centre on organizer site, BMO Centre in a snippet); Montreal (Laval on organizer site, Place Bonaventure in the PreGrade guide); Vancity 2026 (Vancouver Convention Centre West on organizer site, Croatian Cultural Centre in the PreGrade guide). Currency: several pages show dollar prices without naming the currency (Vault, Vancity 2025, Sport Card Expo Montreal 2025, Lethbridge, Festival Hobby, Quebec City). Per the currency rule I did not assign CAD; prices are in admission notes with the currency left unnamed. The Vancity 2025 date (Sept 19 to 21) and other weekdays were checked with Bash. Known list item Treasure Cup Montreal (Carta Magica) was not re-researched; no new dates or vendor info came up. Shops, not shows, skipped: Imperial Garden Sports Collectibles (Grande Prairie AB) and Backyard Rink Sports Cards (Prince George BC). A Burnaby coin and stamp show on Nov 21 2026 is not card-focused and was skipped. Gaps with no dated card show found for Nov to Dec 2026: Winnipeg, Regina, Red Deer, Grande Prairie, Victoria, Kelowna, Surrey, Prince George, Moncton, Saint John, Charlottetown, Newfoundland (beyond the 2022 item), and Quebec outside Montreal and Quebec City. Searches for these returned only stamp, coin, TCG-hotel or out-of-region results. Listing sites (cardpulse, treasurehunter, thecardshopfinder) were used for leads only, never fetched.
